title: ctenolepis garcinii
intro: Ctenolepis garcinii, commonly known as the Garcinia cambogia's close relative, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The Ctenolepis garcinii plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including aiding in weight loss, reducing inflammation, and lowering cholesterol levels. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to inhibit the activity of citrate lyase, an enzyme involved in fat production, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Ctenolepis garcinii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
